name: himvigil
description: HimVigil - A community-focused hazard index and offline-ready alerting prototype for Himalayan avalanches, flash floods, and GLOF risk awareness.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ML-SERVICE" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" ".venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn main:app --port 8000 --app-dir ml-service"
